name: Untitled UI (React + Figma)
licence: React base components: MIT (github.com/untitleduico/react LICENSE, Copyright 2025 Untitled UI); PRO components, Figma kit PRO and marketing/dashboard templates are paid, one-time licence with no redistribution or resale. This study uses only the public docs (llms.txt, AGENT.md, theming/dark-mode/typography .md), the MIT repo files theme.css/globals.css/typography.css/button.tsx/input.tsx and the Tailwind v4 default theme. No PRO content was read.
bestFor: B2B SaaS marketing sites and dashboards
teams who want Figma and React in lockstep with identical names
fast brand re-skin by swapping one 11-step brand ramp
avoidFor: distinctive or editorial brands (the Untitled look is extremely common)
anything needing a non-Inter type voice without redoing the scale
projects that cannot pay for PRO sections (most marketing/app patterns are PRO)

families: Inter via --font-inter fallback -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Arial, sans-serif (both --font-body and --font-display)
mono: ui-monospace, 'Roboto Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas
typography.notes: Tokens defined as calc(var(--spacing) * n) so type sizes sit on the 4px grid (3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 6, 7.5, 9, 12, 15, 18 x 4px). Display sizes md and up get -0.02em tracking; below that none. Body smoothing: antialiased, contextual ligatures, kerning normal. Heading weights in typography.css prose: 600 for h1-h4, 500 for lead paragraph. Line-height ratios: 1.5 at xs-md (18/12, 20/14, 24/16), 1.556 at lg (28/18), 1.5 at xl (30/20), about 1.2-1.25 at display-md and up (44/36, 60/48, 72/60, 90/72).

color.model: rgb() in theme.css for brand; neutral/red/green/yellow/etc. reference Tailwind v4 default oklch palettes (Tailwind v4.2 palette per v8.0 release); semantic layer references them

neutrals.palette: Tailwind neutral (theme.css semantic tokens reference --color-neutral-*; the earlier gray-based palette is not read here)
neutrals.note: Neutrals are chroma 0. CLI init lets you pick any Tailwind palette (slate, gray, zinc, neutral, stone) as neutral/brand.

accents.brandNote: Default brand is a purple (600 = #7F56D9). Brand ramp has 11 steps 50-950 (AGENT.md also mentions 25). Primary interactive = 600, hover = 700, focus ring = 500. Status/utility ramps: error=red, warning=yellow, success=green; badge colours also gray, brand, error, warning, success, slate, sky, blue, indigo, purple, pink, rose, orange; utility ramps exist for amber, blue, brand, emerald, fuchsia, green, indigo, neutral, orange, pink, purple, red, sky, slate, yellow.

semantic.layers: Semantic CSS vars exposed as Tailwind utilities with property-less names: text-primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary/placeholder/brand-primary/brand-secondary/error-primary/success-primary/warning-primary, bg-primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary/overlay/brand-solid/brand-primary/brand-secondary/error-solid/success-solid/warning-solid/primary-solid/brand-section, border-primary/secondary/tertiary/brand/error/error_subtle, fg-primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary/brand-primary/brand-secondary/error-primary/success-primary/warning-primary, focus-ring (brand-500) and focus-ring-error (red-500). Suffix _hover, _alt, _on-brand add state/context variants.

darkMapping.text-brand-secondary: neutral-300 (brand text becomes neutral in dark)

color.darkMode: Class-based: add `dark-mode` to any element (custom variant dark = &:where(.dark-mode, .dark-mode *)); only dark-mode is defined (no light-mode), so nested light islands inside dark need overrides. Components never write dark: classes: they use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-primary) that remap inside .dark-mode. alpha-white/alpha-black tokens invert (white -> rgb(12 14 18); black -> white). Brand text and several brand foregrounds deliberately fall back to neutral in dark mode.
color.contrastNotes: No numeric contrast targets published in docs read. Primary button: white text on brand-600 (#7F56D9) with 60%-white icons. Disabled state is a flat opacity-50 across all components (v8) instead of per-token disabled colours.

spacing.notes: Uses the full Tailwind spacing scale; component padding mostly 2/2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5 steps (8-18px). Container max-width 1280px (--max-width-container). Breakpoints: xxs 320px, xs 600px (matched to Sonner), then Tailwind sm 640 / md 768 / lg 1024 / xl 1280 / 2xl 1536.

scale.token: rounded-lg (default for buttons, inputs, cards sm)

radius.rule: No custom radius tokens: Tailwind radius scale. Buttons and inputs rounded-lg (8px) at every size; buttons add an inner `before` highlight element with radius 7px (1px inside the 8px outer). Prose code blocks use --radius-xl, inline code --radius-sm / 6px.

shadows: modern-mockup inner/outer shadow sets for device frames
depth.borders: Inset ring-1 (ring-primary / ring-secondary) rather than border; primary buttons add an inner 1px white/12% gradient edge (before:border-white/12 masked to bottom). Inputs: ring-1 ring-primary shadow-xs, focus ring-2 ring-brand, invalid ring-error_subtle / ring-2 ring-error.

motion.notes: Default micro transition is `transition duration-100 ease-linear` (100ms linear) for hover/colour changes. Inputs: transition-shadow duration-100 ease-linear. Libraries: motion (Framer Motion), tailwindcss-animate; @keyframes marquee, caret-blink. Overlay animation values live in component source (not read).

modes: sizes xs, sm, md, lg, xl for Button (default sm); sm, md, lg for Input/Select/Badge; sm, md for Checkbox

controlHeightsPx.note: Derived from padding + line-height in button.tsx/input.tsx (e.g. sm = py-2 (16px) + text-sm line-height 20px)

components.figma: 10,000+ components and variants (marketing figure from llms.txt; Figma file contents are PRO and not inspected)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Button: 5 sizes x 9 colours (primary, secondary, tertiary, link-gray, link-color, primary-destructive, secondary-destructive, tertiary-destructive, link-destructive) x states (hover, focus-visible outline-2 offset-2, loading with optional text, disabled opacity-50, icon-only via data-icon-only padding, leading/trailing icons, in-input-group joins). Input: 3 sizes x default/hover/focus-within/invalid/invalid+focus/disabled, with label, hint, tooltip, shortcut, leading/trailing icon. Badge: 3 sizes x 13 colours x 3 types (pill-color, color, modern) x with-dot/with-icon. Checkbox 2 sizes x selected/indeterminate/disabled/hint. Spec rigour: every base component is a React Aria component, so keyboard/ARIA states come from RAC.

tokenArchitecture: Three tiers in a Tailwind v4 @theme block. (1) Primitive ramps: --color-brand-50..950 (rgb) plus Tailwind palettes (neutral, red, green, yellow, etc.). (2) Utility ramps: --color-utility-{hue}-50..700 map light ramps to dark by reversing (e.g. utility-blue-50 = blue-950 in dark) for badges and tags. (3) Semantic: --color-{text|fg|bg|border}-{role}[_state]; role names are primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary (hierarchy) and brand/error/warning/success (intent); suffix `_hover`, `_alt`, `_on-brand`. (4) Component colours (--color-slider-handle-bg, --color-toggle-border, --color-tooltip-supporting-text, --color-featured-icon-*). Property-prefixed aliases (--background-color-X, --text-color-X) let Tailwind bg-X/text-X work without the property word. Styles organised in components via sortCx({common,sizes,colors}) objects. Folders: components/base, application, foundations, marketing, shared-assets. Files kebab-case; react-aria-components imports aliased Aria*.
distinctiveness: Precise skeuomorphic-lite buttons: inset 1px ring + inner gradient highlight + 2px bottom inner shade (shadow-xs-skeuomorphic); purple brand 600; semantic tokens named by hierarchy (primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary) applied uniformly to text, fg (icons), bg and border; soft multi-layer drop shadows; Inter everywhere.
weaknesses: Instantly recognisable and over-used; reads as 'default SaaS'
Large share of the useful library (marketing, app patterns, Figma depth) is paid
Single typeface (Inter) with no display voice
Semantic names mix hierarchy and intent (text-tertiary vs text-error-primary)
Dark mode brand colours collapse to neutrals, losing identity
Only a dark-mode class exists (no explicit light island)
Docs are Tailwind-coupled; tokens not exportable as W3C JSON
takeaways: Name semantic tokens by hierarchy (primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary) and apply the same ladder to text, icons (fg), backgrounds and borders
Components never contain dark: classes; dark mode is a re-mapping of semantic tokens
Define one brand ramp (50-950) and let the CLI swap it for any Tailwind palette
Single disabled treatment (opacity 50, not-allowed) for every component
Button spec = size x colour matrix with icon-only, loading and joined-in-input-group modes, sizes tied to explicit padding + line-height so heights are derivable (32/36/40/44/48)
Encode the micro-transition default (100ms linear) once and reuse
Ship agent docs (AGENT.md, .md per page, llms.txt, MCP, CLI) next to the component code
